clips.start_words: When you have done billions and billions
clips.send: A friend stuck choosing safe 20% returns sends this in anger that insiders get 500X on the same money.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the real gap between the rich and everyone else isn't talent - it's who tells you about an idea before it goes public.

He says he knew about satellite dishes on every rooftop ten years before Direct TV ever launched, because of the rooms he was in. Knowing something that early, you don't settle for a normal 20% return. You get in at the very beginning, and a stake can turn into 100 or 500 times what you put in.

That's the real difference: not more effort. Earlier information.

Comment BRAIN and I'll send you more on how this works.
